falsifier: A pair accepted by prove_address_fold or _apply_address_fold that differs in normal-completion load address/value, any final GPR/flags/memory, or reaches a changed window through an unguarded interior entry; add its encoded instructions/ELF fixture to tools/gdl/tests/test_address_fold.py. An accepted malformed relocation or failed hash/datum binding is also a counterexample.
subject: tool:webfrank
value: Reviewed narrow relational-value subcase: address_fold supports exactly one contiguous non-record/non-OE add; nonzero-RA addi; nonzero-RA lwz temporary/base forwarding window. One stream loads through its temporary with displacement K+D, the other through its advanced persistent base with displacement D. Signed displacement equality, common ordered add inputs, identical pointer/load destinations, equal effective load addresses, and all 32 final GPR expressions are independently required. The symbolic expressions are affine modulo 2^32, with one identical final word-load token. No memory write, flag, instruction count or control operation changes. The entire body outside the twelve-byte window must already equal the hash-bound target. No other stage/options may compose with it; window relocations and all discovered interior entries (branches, local calls, symbols, address-taking relocations) refuse. Whole-function input/target/output hashes, relocation shape and normal datum binding remain mandatory. Only SDA21's documented word+2 versus word+0 encoding convention is normalized, with duplicate relocations refused. This is a separate proof, never a broadened register mask or an arbitrary equivalent-stream facility.
